metadata.note: Example-only working inputs from the Netherlands research benchmark. Non-canonical.
metadata.working_assumption_note: variable_cost_per_saleable_kg and fixed_batch_cost are constructed review-only working assumptions for the first example run. They are not mechanically derived from benchmark labour or electricity rates.

approval.scope: B1 + B2: Netherlands basil wholesale price 7/8/9 EUR/kg and saleability 0.85/0.90/0.95, for scenario estimates only (not canon)
